content: Kubernetes ecosystem history (kubectl cp CVE-2018-1002100, CVE-2019-1002101, CVE-2019-11249) shows tar consumers that extract untrusted archives are prone to path traversal and symlink escapes; decompression bombs amplify DoS. Offline support-bundle analyzers must stream-scan with caps, reject .. and absolute paths, and avoid unbounded ReadAll/extract-to-disk.
